messages.ingestUrlPendingSave: Save this source to reveal the ingest URL.

tooltips.ingestUrl: Public URL to POST events to. The path id is the row id — anyone with this URL can attempt ingestion, so always set a signing secret for production sources.
tooltips.signingSecret: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to verify the X-Tracking-Signature header. Strongly recommended for every source — without it, anyone with the ingest URL can post events.
tooltips.allowedOrigins: One CORS origin per line (e.g. https://www.example.com). Only honoured for kind=Website — browser ingestion is blocked unless the Origin matches.
tooltips.allowUnknownEventCode: If true, ingestion auto-creates a TrackingEventType (category=Custom) for unknown codes. Turn off once your event dictionary stabilises.
tooltips.lastEventError: Last non-success status reason. Updated on every ingest attempt regardless of outcome.
tooltips.tenant: Derived from the first selected team via Tenant.baseUserTeam. Set automatically by the AssignTenantFromTeam hook — assign teams to populate this.
